## Who we are

The **Open Geomatics Education Group** is a collective of university teachers and researchers in geomatics, geodesy, surveying and geospatial sciences. The collection is published under the group's name; each resource lists its individual authors, contributors and reviewers.

## How to cite

**The whole collection**

> Open Geomatics Education Group (2026). *Open Geomatics Education: open teaching resources in geomatics* (Version 1.0) [Educational material]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX

**A single resource** — use the citation shown on its page, which includes its own authors and DOI.

## Licences

- Text, exercises, figures and worksheets content: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
- Source code (JavaScript, Python, CSS): [MIT License](https://opensource.org/license/mit).
- Third-party material (photos, maps, datasets) is excluded and marked with its own licence where it appears.
